description: POST /v1/webhooks - registers a new webhook endpoint. Returns the endpoint summary and rawSecret (shown once - cache it). Requires an API key (sk_*).

apiVersion.description: Pin the endpoint's payload shape to a contract version (currently "2026-10-02"). Omit for latest — the shape may then evolve.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Defaults to ["session.confirming"]. Valid: "session.confirming" (payment detected, settlement starting — no result fields), "session.partial" (funds arrived below the session amount; amountReceived is the leading chain's received amount; per-chain balances are in amountReceivedByChain), "session.completed" (tokens delivered, payload carries what landed: deliveredChainId and deliveredAssets [{ symbol, tokenAddress, decimals, amount }] with raw on-chain amounts, plus tokenReceived, usdeAmount, sUsdeAmount, and payoutChainId/payoutAddress — the normalize payout target, present only when one was configured), "session.expired" (the session expired unpaid or partially paid; carries the final amountPaid and amountRemaining), "session.cancelled" (the merchant cancelled the unpaid session — terminal; carries cancelledAt), "session.payment_detected" (any observed increase in an underpaying session's per-chain balance, including sub-cent deposits; carries amountPaid and amountRemaining), "session.failed" (settlement failed after payment was detected; carries failureReason), "balance.low" (prepaid balance running low; data.balance carries balanceUsd, burnRatePerDayUsd and daysLeft — no session) and "balance.exhausted" (prepaid balance ran out and sponsored operations stop; data.balance carries balanceUsd — no session).

mode.description: Routing mode: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. The endpoint is always assigned that mode.

name: webhooks_create
title: Register webhook endpoint
